pre_stated_hypothesis.name: Quote Volume Acceleration Trend Following (Volume-Z ROC Confirmation)
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Trend-follow using acceleration of normalized quote volume: compute vol_z ROC = vol_z(t)-vol_z(t-12). Enter long when ROC>0.5 and ret24>0.5% (accelerating volume into uptrend); short when ROC>0.5 and ret24<-0.5%. Exit on ROC fade (<0), max hold 24h, or flip. Execution t->t+1. WF 720/168/168, cost grid 0-40bps, B&H benchmark on same OOS windows.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 uses high vol_z LEVEL surge for momentum continuation; C44 uses vol_z ROC (acceleration/delta), not level.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades HIGH vol climax (mean reversion); C44 follows trend on positive volume acceleration.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 enters on LOW vol dry-up breakout continuation; C44 requires positive volume acceleration aligned with trend.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 confirms price breakout with volume expansion level; C44 uses vol_z ROC signal with trend alignment, no breakout/extreme condition.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c43: C43 fades price extremes on WEAK volume confirmation (divergence); C44 follows trend on ACCELERATING volume (opposite).

summary.edge_rule: exposure>0 AND all cost-grid slices OOS net>0 AND OOS net>B&H on same OOS windows (pre-stated, fail-closed)
